repositoryNativeProblem.statement: A repository can contain a real defect that its existing tests do not cover, while the cost of looking for one is a maintainer's attention rather than compute.
evidence: Stated contracts in documentation, type signatures, docstrings, and existing test expectations
The repository's own test suite and the commands it already runs
Source at one immutable revision, replayed in a fresh environment

eligibleOpportunity.identity: One authorized public repository at one immutable revision, with a bounded focus surface that states a checkable behavioral contract and has an existing test command.
eligibleOpportunity.predicate: The repository is explicitly within CAO policy scope, its focus files are readable with the available token, and the campaign can set up and run the repository's own tests.
eligibleOpportunity.missingEvidence: An unreadable repository, an unresolvable revision, or a failed environment setup is blocked, not an eligible zero and not a no-finding.

intendedOutcome.statement: Give a maintainer at most one reviewable record per run that contains a reproduced defect and a separately verified repair, or an explicit, honest no-finding.
intendedOutcome.actorIndependence: A maintainer, another agent, or an upstream change may resolve the same defect; the record is still counted by the reviewed outcome, not by authorship.

outcomeAttainmentEvidence.rationale: Operational value for this campaign is whether a maintainer accepts a surfaced finding. That signal does not exist until reviewed runs produce review decisions, so no deterministic evaluator is declared in this first release rather than scoring an unvalidated proxy.

priorEvidence.label: historical-pilot-evidence
priorEvidence.caution: One pre-release pilot across three pinned repositories and 998 selected existing tests produced two maintainer-unreviewed candidates. It is not a yield estimate and not a promise that a run finds a bug.

outcomeAttainmentEvidence.zeroRule: A completed investigation that clears setup and finds no contradicted contract records zero review-ready findings.
outcomeAttainmentEvidence.missingRule: A blocked run, including denied admission, missing model access, or failed environment setup, records missing rather than zero.

targetPopulation.scope: Repositories explicitly authorized by the reviewed CAO control policy, defaulting to one.
targetPopulation.eligibility: Public repositories readable with the built-in workflow token whose focus surface has a stated contract and a runnable test command.

triggerAndSchedule.manualScope: At most one fully qualified, allowlisted target repository per explicit target_repo input.

fields.scheduleRationale: The campaign ships without a schedule so that installing it never starts spending model budget. An operator who wants recurring investigation adds a schedule deliberately, after a first manual run has shown what one investigation costs and produces.

maxDetectionDelay.appliesTo: Manual-by-default operation has no detection-delay commitment; a defect is found when an operator chooses to look.

resourceEnvelope.rationale: Verification budget is reserved before the investigation phase begins so an unbounded search can never consume the budget that checking the result requires.

overlapIdentity.workKey: repository + immutable revision + hypothesis version + harness version
overlapIdentity.opportunityKey: repository + violated contract + symptom signature + entry point
overlapIdentity.rationale: Work identity changes when the code or the method changes, so a new revision is new work. Finding identity excludes revision, harness, and run so the same defect is recognized across repeat investigations instead of surfacing near-duplicates.

outputApprovalPolicy.review: Publish one artifact-backed review bundle and at most one deduplicated review issue in the control repository.
outputApprovalPolicy.live: Not offered. The campaign is review-only: it opens no upstream issue or pull request and merges nothing.
outputApprovalPolicy.humanDecision: A maintainer decides whether the finding is real and whether the repair is acceptable. The campaign never makes that decision.

maturationPeriod.appliesTo: A surfaced review record expires after 14 days if no maintainer acts on it.

deduplication.mechanism: Stable finding identity plus deduplicate-by-title on the single review issue.
deduplication.incrementalSkip: An already-completed work identity is skipped instead of reinvestigated, and an open finding identity suppresses a second record for the same defect.

backoff.rationale: The worker never waits for budget replenishment and never redispatches itself; a later authorized run is a new attempt.

stopConditions: Admission denied by the campaign kill switch or policy scope.
One investigation completed, whatever its outcome.
Investigation budget consumed down to the verification reserve.
Model access unavailable or AI credit budget exhausted.
Environment setup failed after the bounded retry plan.

operationalValueDefinition.statement: Value is a maintainer-accepted finding. Until reviewed runs produce accepted or rejected decisions, this campaign reports outcomes honestly and declines to score itself.
antiMetrics: Number of candidates surfaced without review
Passing test runs after a patch
